plotting_plan.title: Inventory, review status, and qualifying claim backing
plotting_plan.objective: Horizontal bars or three separate panels. Inventory uses n=3,754 concept records across five classes, review status uses the same 3,754 concepts, claim backing uses n=17,229 claims. Note no records are independently reviewed and no claims backed by a human check. Neither plot estimates correctness or prevalence.
